DEF 14A. Annual Meeting of Stockholders, June 3, 2026.

Election of Directors

Dorian Vexley-Marsh, age 54, has served as a director of Pelagic Systems since 2019 and chairs the compensation committee. He is the chairman of Halcyon Reef Capital and previously served as our Chief Operating Officer from 1998 to 2003.

Director compensation: in fiscal 2025 Mr. Vexley-Marsh received total compensation of $215,000, consisting of cash fees and stock awards.
